column1: # The one-line description under each tier header. Source of truth — all six filled.

column2: The undisputed top six programs. The data separates them clearly from the rest. Each backed by sustained excellence and national relevance across multiple eras.
Squarely behind the undisputed six, yet clearly above the rest of the pack. Their histories carry too much weight to ignore, and the numbers place them firmly in the tier just below the inner circle.

The next tier of contenders, where the path to the top is less defined. Each has the history and foundation to make a run at blue blood status, but needs additional decades of sustained success or a truly dominant era to close the gap.
Programs the whole country knows, with real title history. The band runs from genuine current risers to powers coasting on an era two or three decades back.
Recognisable names and real trophy cases, but a clear class break below the powers. Also where newer programs still accruing the cumulative totals land.
Everyone else — mostly regional followings and thin résumés, plus the young programs whose ceilings haven’t been tested by the counting stats.
